title: Mega's Resource Pack
description: for fans and not fans MegaChromeX RP that change game!
body:
This resource pack maded for fans and not fans MegaChromeX. He can help you upgrade your PvP skill and add some cute items in game, because you need download it! 

This RP changing a lot of a textures and models for some items made game better. Also resource pack have easter eggs that you can find just play!
In main resource pack changing textures tools, weapons and common items.

If you don't know who is MegaChromeX, you can visit [My channel](https://www.youtube.com/@megachromex) :D
